G. K. Chesterton, The Incredulity of Father Brown.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/g-k-chesterton/the-incredulity-of-father-brown

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- G. K. Chesterton, the author, died 1936 (Wikidata Q183167, P570 = 1936-06-14).

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'The Incredulity of Father Brown was published in 1926 by G. K. Chesterton.'). Wikipedia says the book was first published as a book in 1926 by Cassell of London.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1926, before 1931, so the United States public domain applies. The edition's own statement of rights, quoted below, says so.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): the text was first published in London in 1926. Copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last person named above, G. K. Chesterton, who died in 1936. The work entered the public domain there on 1 January 2007.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: 'The Incredulity of Father Brown was published in 1926 by G. K. Chesterton.'
- Wikipedia, 'The Incredulity of Father Brown', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Incredulity_of_Father_Brown: 'It was first published as a book in 1926 by Cassell of London'.
- Wikidata Q183167 (G. K. Chesterton), P570 = 1936-06-14.
